cfr_execution.scenario_cycle: exact R7.4 TRUE_HEADS_UP / THREE_HANDED scenario cycles

behavior.iteration_1: uniform over state-local deduplicated PF0 effective legal actions
behavior.iterations_2_to_3: accepted R7.3/R7.5.4 uncertainty-damped four-member Advantage ensemble generalized only to SPNNIV3 model inference
behavior.regret_matching: per member over state-local deduplicated ten-action legal mask
behavior.mean_policy: arithmetic mean of four member regret-matching policies
behavior.disagreement: mean total-variation distance of each member policy from ensemble mean

advantage_fit.side_member_init_seed_formula: training_seed XOR 0x0E115EED XOR (iteration*0x9E3779B1) XOR (member*0x045D9F3B), masked to 31 bits
advantage_fit.side_member_batch_seed_formula: training_seed XOR 0xBA7C8A11 XOR (iteration*0x85EBCA77) XOR (member*0xC2B2AE3D), masked to 64 bits
advantage_fit.primary_member_rng: one persistent bundle.batch_rng in execution order
advantage_fit.side_member_rng: independent Python RNG per frozen batch_seed; never perturbs primary

average_policy_fit.reservoir: candidate-native strategy reservoir accumulated across all three iterations

checkpoint_contract.durable_boundary: after every completed CFR iteration and after final AveragePolicy fit
must_preserve: Advantage and Strategy reservoirs including items/seen/internal RNG
checkpoint_contract.global_torch_rng: audit-only; load must not restore or depend on it

fairness_rule: H2 and H3 receive identical chance schedules, CFR roots, optimizer-step counts, ensemble algebra, learning rates and evaluation seeds. H3 is allowed its larger frozen network/semantic preprocessing because representation capacity itself is the treatment under test.
mutation_rule: Any training hyperparameter, seed formula, ensemble coefficient, root count, iteration count or action candidate change after strategic outputs requires a new explicitly versioned experiment and cannot overwrite Phase 2.
